description_en: Queries the backup status of servers that are associated with an anti-ransomware backup policy
description_zh: 查询防勒索备份策略的服务器备份状态
name: DescribeBackupMachineStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the anti-ransomware backup policy.
You can call the [DescribeBackupPolicies](~~DescribeBackupPolicies~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
防勒索备份策略的ID。
调用[DescribeBackupPolicies](~~DescribeBackupPolicies~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server to query.
You can call the [DescribeBackupPolicy](~~DescribeBackupPolicy~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的服务器的UUID。
调用[DescribeBackupPolicy](~~DescribeBackupPolicy~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The version of the protection policy. Valid values:

1.0.0: The version of the protection policy is 1.0.0.
2.0.0: The version of the protection policy is 2.0.0
parameters.help_zh:
防护策略的版本。取值：

1.0.0：表示防护策略的版本为1.0.0
2.0.0：表示防护策略的版本为2.0.0
parameters.name: policy_version

BackupMachineStatus.description_en: The backup status of the server

ClientId.description_en: The ID of the anti-ransomware client

ClientStatus.description_en:
The service status. Valid values:

ONLINE: Normal.
CLIENT_CONNECTION_ERROR: Client connection exception.
UNINSTALLING: Uninstalling.
UNINSTALL_FAILED: Uninstall failed.
UPGRADING: Upgrading.
UPGRADE_FAILED: Upgrade failed
ClientStatus.description_zh:
服务状态。取值：

ONLINE：状态正常
CLIENT_CONNECTION_ERROR：客户端连接异常
UNINSTALLING：卸载中
UNINSTALL_FAILED：卸载失败
UPGRADING：升级中
UPGRADE_FAILED：升级失败

ClientVersion.description_en: The version number of the anti-ransomware client

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned for an abnormal status
ErrorCode.description_zh: 异常状态返回的错误码

ErrorList.description_en: The list of error messages reported by the backup server
ErrorList.description_zh: 备份服务器上报的错误信息列表

items.description_en: The fault message reported by the backup server
items.description_zh: 备份服务器上报的错误信息

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the server instance

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the server

ServiceStatus.description_en:
The service status. Valid values:
SERVICE_EXCEPTION: Service exception.
RESTORING: Restoring.
BACKING_UP: Backing up
ServiceStatus.description_zh:
服务状态。取值：
SERVICE_EXCEPTION：服务异常
RESTORING：恢复中
BACKING_UP：备份中

Status.description_en:
The status of the anti-ransomware client. Valid values:
NOT_INSTALLED: not installed
CLIENT_CONNECTION_ERROR: client status exception
ACTIVATED: normal
Status.description_zh:
防勒索客户端状态。取值：
NOT_INSTALLED：未安装
CLIENT_CONNECTION_ERROR：客户端状态异常
ACTIVATED：正常

VaultId.description_en: The ID of the backup vault where the backup data is stored
VaultId.description_zh: 备份数据存入的仓库的ID

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
